Section(s): Appendix A. List of model equations (Kontoravdi et al., 2005)

Text and equations in reading order:
    The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
(9) Q_{g l c}=\frac{\mu}{Y_{x,g l c}}+m_{g l c}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{glc}, code proposes constitutive]
(10) \frac{d([G L N])}{d t}=-Q_{g l n}V X_{\nu}-K_{d g l n}V[G L N]+F_{i n}[G L N]_{i n}-F_{o u t}[G L N]    [code: ODE, computes [GLN], code proposes balance]
(11) Q_{g l n}=\frac{\mu}{Y_{x,g l n}}+m_{g l n}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{gln}, code proposes constitutive]
(12) m_{g l n}=\frac{\alpha_{1}[G L N]}{\alpha_{2}+[G L N]}    [code: algebraic, computes m_{gln}, code proposes constitutive]
    The mass balances for lactate and ammonia are
(13) \frac{d([L A C])}{d t}=Q_{l a c}V X_{\nu}-F_{o u t}[L A C]    [code: ODE, computes [LAC], code proposes balance]
(14) Q_{l a c}=Y_{l a c,g l c}Q_{g l c}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{lac}, code proposes constitutive]
(15) \frac{d([{A M M}])}{d t}=Q_{{a m m}}V X_{\nu}+K_{{d g l n}}V[{G L N}]-F_{{o u t}}[{A M M}]    [code: ODE, computes [AMM], code proposes balance]
(16) Q_{a m m}=Y_{a m m,g l n}Q_{g l n}    [code: algebraic, computes Q_{amm}, code proposes constitutive]

Symbols:
  Q_{glc}: Specific glucose consumption rate. [mmol cell^-1 h^-1] (computed)
  \mu: Specific cell growth rate. [h^-1] (computed)
  Y_{x,glc}: Yield of cells on glucose. [cell/mmol] (parameter)
  m_{glc}: Maintenance coefficient of glucose. [mmol/cell-h] (parameter)
  [GLN]: Glutamine concentration in the bioreactor. (computed)
  Q_{gln}: Specific glutamine consumption rate. [mmol cell^-1 h^-1] (computed)
  V: Bioreactor volume. (computed)
  X_{\nu}: Viable cell density. (computed)
  K_{dgln}: Constant for glutamine degradation. [h^-1] (parameter)
  F_{in}: Inlet flow rate. (variable)
  [GLN]_{in}: Glutamine concentration in the bioreactor inlet. (variable)
  F_{out}: Outlet flow rate. (variable)
  Y_{x,gln}: Yield of cells on glutamine. [cell/mmol] (parameter)
  m_{gln}: Specific glutamine consumption rate due to maintenance, given by the glutamine concentration-dependent law. [mmol cell^-1 h^-1] (computed)
  \alpha_{1}: Constant of the glutamine maintenance coefficient. [mM L/cell/h] (parameter)
  \alpha_{2}: Constant of the glutamine maintenance coefficient. [mM] (parameter)
  [LAC]: Lactate concentration [mM] (computed)
  Q_{lac}: Specific lactate production rate. [mM L/cell/h] (computed)
  Y_{lac,glc}: Yield of lactate on glucose. [mmol/mmol] (parameter)
  [AMM]: Ammonia concentration [mM] (computed)
  Q_{amm}: Specific ammonia production rate. [mM L/cell/h] (computed)
  Y_{amm,gln}: Yield of ammonia on glutamine. [mmol/mmol] (parameter)

  (none recorded)

laws.description: Specific glucose uptake is the growth-associated glucose requirement plus glucose maintenance consumption.
laws.quote: The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
laws.law_type_reason: It gives a glucose uptake-rate relationship combining growth-associated demand and maintenance.

laws.description: Glutamine concentration changes through cellular uptake, glutamine degradation, inlet supply, and outlet removal.
laws.quote: The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
laws.law_type_reason: It accounts for glutamine accumulation from cellular uptake, degradation, and flow in and out.
laws.issue: The RHS terms have units of amount/time, while d([GLN])/dt has units of concentration/time; the balance needs division by V or an amount-accumulation LHS.

laws.description: Specific glutamine uptake is the growth-associated glutamine requirement plus glutamine maintenance consumption.
laws.quote: The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
laws.law_type_reason: It gives a glutamine uptake-rate relationship combining growth-associated demand and maintenance.

laws.description: Glutamine-dependent maintenance uptake increases with glutamine concentration and approaches a limiting value.
laws.quote: The mass balances on glucose and glutamine around the bioreactor are:
laws.law_type_reason: It is a concentration-dependent kinetic expression for glutamine maintenance uptake.

laws.description: Lactate concentration accumulates from cell-associated production and decreases through outlet removal.
laws.quote: The mass balances for lactate and ammonia are
laws.law_type_reason: It accounts for lactate accumulation from production and its removal in the outlet flow.
laws.issue: The RHS terms have units of amount/time, while d([LAC])/dt has units of concentration/time; the balance needs division by V or an amount-accumulation LHS.

laws.description: Specific lactate production is calculated from specific glucose consumption using the lactate-on-glucose yield.
laws.quote: The mass balances for lactate and ammonia are
laws.law_type_reason: It defines the lactate production rate as a yield-scaled glucose consumption rate.

laws.description: Ammonia concentration accumulates from cellular production and glutamine degradation, while outlet flow removes ammonia.
laws.quote: The mass balances for lactate and ammonia are
laws.law_type_reason: It accounts for ammonia accumulation from production and glutamine degradation, with outlet removal.
laws.issue: The RHS terms have units of amount/time, while d([AMM])/dt has units of concentration/time; the balance needs division by V or an amount-accumulation LHS.

laws.description: Specific ammonia production is calculated from specific glutamine consumption using the ammonia-on-glutamine yield.

laws.law_type_reason: It defines the ammonia production rate as a yield-scaled glutamine consumption rate.
